title: SystemOneRequest
description: A decision request: one state, many named questions. Wire-compatible with TypeSafe Jev's POST /v1/systemone (ADR-0001) plus local extensions marked x-local.

model.description: Model id. Omit for the server default.

state.description: The unstructured program state the questions are about.

oneOf.description: Blocks in order: strings, and (x-local) image blocks.

prefix.description: x-local. Stable rules/system text that is KV-cached across requests; only `state` is prefilled per call.

ImageBlock.description: x-local. An image in a list state, at its list position. The model sees it where the block sits.

criteria.description: Ordered levels, lowest first. Index is the score.

permutations.description: Ask each question this many times with option order permuted and average, to reduce position bias.

calibrated.description: Apply the fitted temperature. Raw probabilities are always returned alongside.

readout.description: first-token: masked softmax over option-label tokens at the readout position. sequence: teacher-forced loglikelihood of each full option string (ADR-0003).

label_style.description: First-token labels for choice and score options. letters: options are shown as A., B., ... and the model answers a letter. option-text: options are shown by name and the model answers the name, read out at its first token; every name must be a single token in context. noul always uses Yes/No. Ignored in sequence mode, which always scores the option text.

delta_cache.description: Reuse the KV of the longest common token prefix with earlier prompts (the server's delta cache), so only the changed tail is prefilled. false runs this request without it; the declared prefix is cached either way.

debug.description: Include the readout token ids and raw logits in each answer.
